## My Cycle 1.1.5

### Repository and release hardening
- Added a verified Gradle 9.5.0 Wrapper with the official distribution SHA-256 checksum.
- Switched automated Gradle builds to the repository wrapper for reproducible local and CI execution.
- Strengthened the existing protected `build` gate so it only succeeds after CodeQL, Qodana, Semgrep and Gitleaks also succeed.
- The signed release workflow therefore waits on the full quality/security gate before publishing.
- Included the current pinned GitHub Actions maintenance updates and KSP 2.3.11 with strict dependency verification preserved.

This is a maintenance release with no intended user-facing feature or UI changes. The permanent Android Application ID remains `com.sl.mycycle`; period data stays offline-only with no account, analytics, ads or Android `INTERNET` permission.
